# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop 3.0.3 is a community-maintained, open-source Windows AI coding client for DeepSeek Harness. It preserves the complete Harness Web Surface, loads the existing Home and all plugins directly, and handles startup failures with verified transactional repair or same-Home built-ins fallback.

## What it is

- A Windows 10/11 x64 desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness
- A complete Harness interface hosted in a hardened Electron window, not a reduced rewrite
- A community edition, not an official DeepSeek release
- Free under BSD-3-Clause, with no separate Node.js installation required

## Key facts

- Supported systems: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Current release: v3.0.3
- v3.0.3 loads the current DSH Home, persistent profile, conversations, sessions, settings, and all installed plugins directly; it retries the full profile unchanged, may invoke an already configured model in a bounded private repair transaction, applies only verified candidates, and otherwise starts built-in plugins from the same Home without a startup choice screen
- Published assets include `SHA256SUMS.txt` and `release-manifest.json`; the manifest reports the actual per-asset signature state. A local or source build may be unsigned and does not establish the state of a published asset
- Desktop telemetry is disabled by default. Diagnostics are generated only after user confirmation to a selected local location and are redacted to exclude secrets, user content, full prompts, full sessions, tool results, project content, paths, and SSH private keys
- The public website does not automatically report installer clicks; installer links remain direct GitHub Release downloads
- Skin state is isolated in profiles/desktop and legacy global cordis.patch.yml pollution is migrated away so the official dsh web profile remains valid
- Installer preflight supports direct upgrades from 0.1.9 through 2.3 and closes legacy product-name processes even when their old installation path is no longer registered
- Preflight decodes PowerShell EncodedCommand payloads, preserves Windows 8.3 short-path references, falls back to WMI paths when process handles are unavailable, and waits with backoff after forced termination
- The cleanup boundary preserves the official web runtime and unrelated external hosts while matching the uniquely named Desktop main process required by legacy uninstallers
- Desktop uses the isolated profiles/desktop profile and selects an available port when the preferred port is occupied, allowing it to coexist with the official web client
- The bundled Skin Center includes 11 selectable skins
- Node.js is bundled; end users do not need to install it separately
- QQ user community: 1105158177

## Core capabilities

- Complete Harness conversations, tool calls, model selection, permissions, and plugin surfaces
- ChatGPT OAuth, OpenAI Codex models, and model-aware reasoning effort
- Extension Dock for plugins, community bundles, project Skills, DSH Skills, and Agents Skills
- Task board, Git graph, file and change preview, live token statistics, pet, and 11 skins
- Mobile pairing for workspaces, conversations, models, reasoning, and permissions
- SSH terminal, SFTP, port forwarding, cluster execution, and live system monitoring
- Stable/Beta GitHub Release checks, background downloads, bilingual release notes, checksums, release manifests, and user-confirmed installation
